header.title: Lessons learned & project closure
header.crumb: Project · Project review

lessons.what: Steel mill capacity slipped 3 weeks with no early warning
lessons.impact: −27 d float · second mill qualified late
lessons.reco: Qualify two mills at award for structural steel > 200 t

lessons.what: P&ID rev D released while electrical and automation still consumed rev C
lessons.impact: 3 tags missing in schematics and PLC table
lessons.reco: Make revision acknowledgment mandatory before design freeze (Keystone engineering register)

lessons.what: Damp electrodes caused weld porosity on K-12
lessons.reco: Electrode oven and humidity log in the ITP for all site welding

lessons.what: Client decides on hold points only in steering committee
lessons.reco: Add a weekly client technical call with decision authority to the RACI

closure.item: Warranty start recorded in installed base
